name: quickselect
description: Finds the k-th smallest element in an unsorted array in O(N) average time using selection partitioning.
aiPromptContext: Use this block to efficiently retrieve order statistics (like the median or k-th smallest/largest value) without paying the full sorting cost.

parameters.name: arr
parameters.description: The input unsorted array of numbers.

parameters.name: k
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the target order statistic (e.g. 0 for minimum, len-1 for maximum).
